An opt-out for the taller toolbar row, plus dark-theme visibility fixes for the LinkGrabber panel menu and Download Overview icons, and a Light theme hover-highlight fix.

## ✨ Added

- New `JD_COMPACT_TOOLBAR` environment variable. `true` / `1` keeps JDownloader's stock ~32px toolbar row; empty or `false` keeps this image's default of growing the row to 64px so the download speed graph has full height. Contributed by [@milfer322](https://github.com/milfer322) in [#18](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader/pull/18), following up on [#16](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader/issues/16).

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The LinkGrabber panel menu now shows which options are on.** In the LinkGrabber, the "Customize this Bottom Panel" menu (Package or Link Properties, Overview Panel visible, Sidebar visible, Autostart Download and the others) gave no sign of which entries were active, so a toggle looked the same whether it was on or off. Each active entry now carries a small light check badge, so its on and off state is clear at a glance. Entries that ship no icon of their own get one too.
- **The Download Overview panel corner icons are visible again.** The settings (wrench) and close (X) icons in the top corner of the Download Overview panel were a near-invisible dark grey on the dark theme. They are now drawn in light grey, so they read clearly like the panel's other icons.
- **Light theme table-header hover painted solid black.** Hovering a download-table column header (e.g. "Name") with `JD_THEME=Light` painted the entire header cell solid black instead of a subtle hover highlight. Root cause: `FlatDarkLaf.properties` was registered as a custom FlatLaf defaults source, but no `FlatLightLaf.properties` ever existed, so the Light theme's `TableHeader.hoverBackground` fell back to an undefined value. Added `FlatLightLaf.properties` pinning the header hover/pressed colours explicitly. Reported in #16.
